ChoConsumingFire.name: Consuming Fire
ChoConsumingFire.description: Consuming Blaze heals for 150% more when a Hero is Ignited.

ChoCallousedHide.name: Calloused Hide
ChoCallousedHide.description: While under 60% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

ChoTheWillofCho.name: The Will of Cho
ChoTheWillofCho.description: Quest: Killing enemy Minions grants 1 stack of The Will of Cho, and Hero takedowns grant 10 stacks. Gain 1 Armor for every 30 stacks of The Will of Cho, up to a maximum of 10 Armor. This Armor bonus stacks with Ogre Hide.

ChoUppercut.name: Uppercut
ChoUppercut.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Surging Fist deals additional damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their max Health and reduces the cooldown of Surging Fist by 5 seconds.

ChoRollback.name: Rollback
ChoRollback.description: Rune Bomb rolls back to Cho, damaging enemies in its path.

ChoSearedFlesh.name: Seared Flesh
ChoSearedFlesh.description: Each consecutive Basic Attack to enemy Heroes deals 20% more damage, to a maximum of 60% damage. This bonus lasts 5 seconds or until a non-Heroic enemy is attacked.

ChoPowerSurge.name: Power Surge
ChoPowerSurge.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Surging Fist are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Gain 15% Movement Speed while charging Surging Fist and for 2.5 seconds after casting the Ability.

ChoFirestarter.name: Firestarter
ChoFirestarter.description: Basic Attacks against ignited Heroes decreases the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 1 second. Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 3 seconds.

ChoEnragedRegeneration.name: Enraged Regeneration
ChoEnragedRegeneration.description: Each time Cho hits an enemy Hero with an Ability or Basic Attack, he heals for 60 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Gall's Dread Orb receive 35% less healing for 2 seconds.

ChoHeroicAbilityHammerOfTwilight.name: Hammer of Twilight
ChoHeroicAbilityHammerOfTwilight.description: Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 (+4.5% per level) damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds. Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

ChoHeroicAbilityUpheaval.name: Upheaval
ChoHeroicAbilityUpheaval.description: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage.

ChoSurgingDash.name: Surging Dash
ChoSurgingDash.description: While Channeling Surging Fist, Cho heals for 150 (+4% per level) Health per second.

ChoTwilightVeil.name: Twilight Veil
ChoTwilightVeil.description: Activate to increase the Armor bonus of Ogre Hide to 75 for 4 seconds. If cast while Ogre Rage is active, it instantly swaps to Ogre Hide.

ChoTalentMoltenBlock.name: Molten Block
ChoTalentMoltenBlock.description: Activate to enter Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds, damaging nearby enemies for 92 (+4% per level) damage per second.

ChoFrenziedFists.name: Frenzied Fists
ChoFrenziedFists.description: Gain 75% Attack Speed for 5 seconds after using Surging Fist.

ChoRunicFeedback.name: Runic Feedback
ChoRunicFeedback.description: Gall's Runic Blast reduces Cho's Rune Bomb cooldown by 1 second per enemy hit, and 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

ChoRunedGauntlet.name: Runed Gauntlet
ChoRunedGauntlet.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Cho and Gall's Heroic Abilities by 6%.

ChoCthunsGift.name: C'Thun's Gift
ChoCthunsGift.description: Cho's Basic Attack becomes ranged and Slows targets by 20% for 2 seconds.

ChoFavorOfTheOldGods.name: Favor of the Old Gods
ChoFavorOfTheOldGods.description: Upheaval Roots enemy Heroes for 2 seconds.

ChoFuelForTheFlame.name: Fuel for the Flame
ChoFuelForTheFlame.description: Basic Attacks against enemies cause them to explode, dealing 21 (+4% per level) damage to them and 45 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. This damage is doubled against enemy Heroes.
